title: Connectors are gated, not assumed.
summary: The CANONICAL connector spine treats every integration as a confirmed, owner-approved action. Demo mode disables all connector calls. Owner mode gates writes behind spine discovery and approval.

connectors.name: Dropbox
connectors.posture: Treated as the discovered CANONICAL file spine. Spine discovery reads folder metadata only. Save requires explicit owner approval of the discovered spine map.

connectors.name: Google Classroom
connectors.posture: Produces AYA-safe Classroom draft metadata. Does not post live in V1. Owner mode prepares dry-run output for review.

connectors.name: ClickUp
connectors.posture: Produces tagged task candidates. Does not create live ClickUp tasks in V1. Owner mode prepares dry-run output for review.

connectors.name: Gmail / Email
connectors.posture: No live email sending is built or enabled in V1. Future adapter planned.

rules: Demo mode never calls backend connectors — all connector actions are blocked.
Spine discovery reads Dropbox folder metadata only; it never creates, moves, or writes files.
Save to Dropbox requires an approved spine map and a valid, classified packet.
PRISM-private material cannot be exported to Google Classroom or public demo scopes.
Connector tokens are never exposed to the frontend or demo layer.
